title: The Great Journey
description: Long board: Start + tiles 1-202 + END (203 tiles after Start). One continuous journey from Home to the Festival of Lights. cat B = boost, S = setback, C = choice, place = landmark (no effect).

end.title: Festival of Lights
end.text: You made it to the Festival of Lights!

10.title: Forgot your ticket
10.text: Run back home to get it.

15.title: Busy crossing
15.text: Next turn you move just 1 square.

25.title: Bus arrives
25.text: The bus comes right away - throw once more!

30.title: Flat tyre
30.text: Fix your bike: move on with a 4, 5 or 6 (at most 2 tries).

35.title: Tractor ride
35.text: A friendly farmer drives you to the forest.

40.title: Hot-air balloon
40.text: Float over the fields to the river!

45.title: Four-leaf clover
45.text: Throw twice and move the total.

50.title: Rainstorm
50.text: Shelter in the barn - skip 2 turns.

55.title: Forest railway
55.text: Ride the little train to Forest Station.

60.title: Umbrella
60.text: Keep this card: it can protect you from one setback.

65.title: Trail marker
65.text: Follow the marker to the next boost and use it.

75.title: Shared ride
75.text: Swap places with the traveller just ahead of you.

80.title: Canoe trip
80.text: Paddle downstream to the river beach.

85.title: Boat ride
85.text: Sail across the lake to the river beach path.

90.title: Compass
90.text: Keep this card: throw again once when you like.

95.title: Bridge repairs
95.text: Wait 1 turn while the bridge is fixed.

97.title: Path through the reeds
97.text: Take the shortcut? Throw: 4-6 you jump ahead, 1-3 you wait 1 turn. Or stay on the path.

101.title: Wrong turn
101.text: You took the wrong path around the lake - go back.

108.title: Mountain bus
108.text: Take the bus up the first bends of the mountain road.

110.title: Cable car
110.text: Ride up now and skip your next turn - or keep walking.

113.title: Muddy slide
113.text: Whoops! Slide back down to the lake shore.

118.title: Goat path
118.text: A mountain goat shows you a shortcut.

123.title: Snowball
123.text: Roll like a snowball: throw twice and move the total.

128.title: Thick fog
128.text: You get lost in the fog: go to the next setback and take it.

133.title: Lodge is full
133.text: No room tonight - walk back down a little.

138.title: Great Snake Slide
138.text: Ride the Great Snake down to the beach - you become the Snake Leader!

143.title: Photo stop
143.text: You stop for photos - everyone else doubles their next throw.

145.title: Beach umbrella
145.text: Keep this card: it can protect you from one setback.

148.title: Ferry delayed
148.text: Move on with a 4, 5 or 6 (at most 2 tries).

153.title: Beach buggy
153.text: Catch a buggy ride - swap places with the traveller just ahead of you.

158.title: Sleepy snake
158.text: A sleepy snake carries you back along the beach.

163.title: Green lights
163.text: All traffic lights are green - throw once more!

168.title: Invitation
168.text: You are invited to the City Fair!

170.title: City map
170.text: Keep this card: throw again once when you like.

183.title: Wrong tram
183.text: Oops, wrong tram - ride back to the City Fair.

188.title: Wrong exit
188.text: You took the wrong exit - wait 1 turn to find the way.

190.title: Last hill
190.text: Sprint ahead now (next turn you move just 1) - or walk.

193.title: Forgot keys!
193.text: Run back a little to get your keys.

198.title: Forgot keys AGAIN!!!
198.text: Wait 1 turn while a friend brings them.

202.title: Snake Leader's duty
202.text: Snake Leaders only: follow the snake back to the city.
